name: walk_line
note: r.walk draws the line (Langmuir coefficients, lambda 0.6 - the old router's settings), r.cost still makes the corridor. Three spreads per route. Lines identical to 'walk'. 1.56x the compute of r.cost (4.8 vs 3.1 s/route). The r.walk line stays inside the r.cost corridor on 95 of 96 tours. See config.WALK.
